notes.title: Camera control changes
notes.notes:
The first update for Royal Tumble is now available. 

In addition to some bug fixes, the camera control system has been rewritten. You can now pan and rotate the camera freely in all modes, completely independent of the castle. Please see in-game for more details.

I hope you like the update. More content coming soon.
